decks.name: German Essentials
decks.summary: German for a trip to Germany, Austria or Switzerland: stations, cafés, places to stay, signs, and help when something goes wrong.

decks.name: Core German Words
decks.summary: First German words for beginners, with der, die or das on every noun and the plural in the notes. Checked against the Goethe-Institut A1 word list.

decks.name: Everyday German Conversation
decks.summary: Whole German sentences for a beginner's first conversations, with Sie for strangers and du for friends and peers.

decks.name: German A1 Vocabulary
decks.summary: Learn 248 German A1 vocabulary words across 13 everyday topics, with der, die or das on every noun and plurals in the notes. Checked against the Goethe-Zertifikat A1 (Start Deutsch 1) word list; A1-oriented, not an official or complete exam list.

decks.name: German A2 Vocabulary
decks.summary: Learn 282 German A2 vocabulary words across 16 everyday topics that follow on from A1, with der, die or das on every noun, plurals in the notes and Perfekt forms for irregular verbs. Checked against the Goethe-Zertifikat A2 word list; Goethe A2-oriented, not an official or complete exam list.

decks.name: German B1 Vocabulary
decks.summary: Learn 335 German B1 vocabulary words across 16 topics, with der, die or das on every noun, plurals in the notes and the preposition and case a verb takes. German law sets B1 as the language level for citizenship. Words are on the Goethe-Zertifikat B1 word list and not on the A2 list; B1-oriented, not an official or complete exam list.

decks.name: German at the Doctor
decks.summary: 61 German phrases for the doctor's and the pharmacy in Germany, from booking an appointment to describing symptoms.

decks.name: Polish Essentials
decks.summary: Polish for a trip around Poland: stations, restaurants, places to stay, and everyday help.

decks.name: Everyday Polish Conversation
decks.summary: Beginner Polish for first conversations, using the polite pan and pani with people you have just met and ty with friends.

decks.name: Polish A1 Vocabulary
decks.summary: 249 A1-level Polish words in 14 sections, organised by the topics of the A1 Polish exam, with genders, irregular forms and short examples. Chosen by A1 topic; not an official or complete exam list.

decks.name: Core Polish Words
decks.summary: Beginner Polish nouns, verbs and adjectives, with the forms you need to use them, chosen against the topics of Poland's state A1 exam.

decks.name: Polish B1 Vocabulary
decks.summary: Learn 287 Polish B1 words in 16 sections, chosen by the B1 topics of the Polish state certificate exam, the level currently asked for in Polish citizenship applications. Follows Polish A2 Vocabulary. Chosen by B1 topic; B1-oriented, not an official or complete exam list.

decks.name: Polish A2 Vocabulary
decks.summary: Learn 289 Polish A2 words in 16 sections, chosen by the A2 topics of the Polish state certificate exam, for everyday life in Poland. Picks up after Polish A1 Vocabulary and leads into Polish B1 Vocabulary without repeating either. Chosen by A2 topic; A2-oriented, not an official or complete exam list.

decks.name: Polish for Offices and Paperwork
decks.summary: 50 Polish words and phrases for offices and paperwork in Poland: PESEL, address registration, residence and forms.

decks.name: Czech Essentials
decks.summary: Czech for a trip around Czechia, from tram tickets and pub tables to shops, signs and unexpected problems.

decks.name: Core Czech Words
decks.summary: Everyday Czech words for a beginner, with gender, irregular forms and common traps in the notes.

decks.name: Everyday Czech Conversation
decks.summary: The sentences a beginner says in a first conversation in Czech, from introductions to making plans.

decks.name: Czech A1 Vocabulary
decks.summary: Practice 240 beginner Czech words across 14 everyday topics, with gender, irregular forms and examples in the notes. Checked against the official A1 word list for Czech as a foreign language and the CCE–A1 exam. A1-oriented, not an official or complete list.

decks.name: Czech A2 Vocabulary
decks.summary: Prepare for the Czech A2 exam for permanent residence with 284 words across 15 topics taken from its real situations: offices and documents, housing, work, the doctor and insurance, school, shops, transport, phone and e-mail. Checked against the official A1–A2 word list for that exam, mostly its A2 part, and its model tests, with aspect pairs, forms and examples in the notes. A2-oriented, not an official or complete list.

decks.name: Czech B1 Vocabulary
decks.summary: Learn 305 Czech B1 vocabulary words across 15 topics, with aspect pairs, cases and examples in the notes. Czech law requires Czech at B1 level for citizenship. Words are chosen by B1 topic, following the citizenship language exam, the CCE–B1 model test and the official glossary for the civics test, and mostly go beyond the official A1–A2 word list. B1-oriented, not an official or complete list.

decks.name: Spanish Essentials

decks.name: Everyday Spanish Conversation

decks.name: Spanish A1 Vocabulary

decks.name: Core Spanish Words

decks.name: Spanish A2 Vocabulary

decks.name: Spanish B1 Vocabulary
decks.summary: Learn 304 Spanish B1 vocabulary words across 15 topics, the next step after Spanish A2, with el or la on every noun and subjunctive triggers marked in the notes. Checked against the Instituto Cervantes Plan curricular B1–B2 inventories and the DELE B1 exam guide; B1-oriented, not an official or complete DELE B1 list.

decks.name: French Essentials

decks.name: Core French Words

decks.name: French A1 Vocabulary
decks.summary: Learn 252 French A1 vocabulary words across 13 everyday topics, with le, la or les on every noun and the gender given where l' hides it. Built around the DELF A1 topics and the Niveau A1 pour le français reference; A1-oriented, not an official or complete exam list.

decks.name: French A2 Vocabulary
decks.summary: Learn 287 French A2 vocabulary words across 16 everyday topics, the next step after French A1 Vocabulary. Every noun has le, la or les, with the gender given where l' hides it, and irregular verbs give their passé composé participle. Built around the DELF A2 topics and the Niveau A2 pour le français reference; A2-oriented, not an official or complete exam list.

decks.name: French B1 Vocabulary
decks.summary: Learn 306 French B1 vocabulary words across 16 topics, the next step after French A2 Vocabulary. Every noun has le, la or les, verbs come with their preposition, and the notes flag false friends and the subjunctive. B1 is the French level asked for a first resident card (carte de résident) since 1 January 2026. Built around the DELF B1 topics and the Niveau B1 pour le français reference; B1-oriented, not an official or complete exam list.
